# runtime-exception

The boundary config's `runtimeExceptions` entry grammar, as a leaf with no
imports. It lives apart from `boundaries/core` so a reader of the grammar (the
plugin-refs file scan) does not load the checker: a plugin record's key follows
the whole closure of every barrel its producer imports, and the boundaries
barrel reaches portability, import-closure and plugin-records.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The boundary config's runtimeExceptions entry grammar ("<zone>.<plugin id>.<folder> -> <zone>.<plugin id>.<folder>"): parseRuntimeException splits one into its two sides. A leaf with no imports, so the plugin-reference locator reads the entries through the checker's own grammar without loading the checker — its file scan's record key follows this module, not the boundaries barrel.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `framework/tooling/boundaries`

- Core:
